## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f7c9b8465b8d5d219b7e8dfb5f15866c100d93e5`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/README.md, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md + none
Security-touching: no

Inputs read: card #36455 (body, 4 comments), PR #36609 (body, 5 files, net diff against merge-base `f4c2d0b1b9`; 3 commits), the check-runs on the head, and the cited code on `origin/main` (`e7399fcd`; no commit since the merge-base touches `skills/`, `field.zod.ts`, `app-shell/src/utils` or the lint rule). The diff has no implementing file: skill prose, an eval fixture, its README, a changeset.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set: unchanged. No schema, no parser, no lint rule and no runtime file is in the diff. Right.
- Public surface: the published `@objectstack/skills` bundle changes its teaching in two files (`SKILL.md` Traps 1 and one "Where to go" row; `rules/list-views.md` container example, "Form Views", "Master-Detail Forms"). The eval fixture and its README are inert in a consumer install. Right: this is a wording change to a published prose package, patch.
- The `os:check` block in `rules/list-views.md` changed (default `form` replaced by `formViews.triage`). Its gate is the head's check-run lane, not a local run: `Type Check · consumer gates` success, `Type Check · source gates` success (the lane that carries the token ratchet, `check:skill-links` and `check:skill-refs` in `lint.yml`).
- Check-runs at my last read (42 runs): success on Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Lint · ESLint, Lint · docs and code guards, Lint · repo and tooling gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, the three scoped lint lanes, the four Type Check lanes and TypeScript Type Check, Build Core, Test UI, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate. No failure. NOT concluded when read: `Lint · CI, release & engine gates` (in progress at the full read), `Test Core (1/10)` and `Test Core (2/10)` (in progress). This record cites no verdict for those three; the adopting seat reads them before adoption.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no. Agreed. The diff publishes skill prose only; nothing a consumer parses, imports or calls changes. `.changeset/36455-ui-skill-create-surfaces.md` declares `@objectstack/skills` patch, which matches, and carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` as the PR body does. Check Changeset: success.

### ③ Boundary flags

- SQL push-down: not applicable. No query, no id materialisation, no join in the diff.
- `open_questions` in the dev report: empty.
- Dev deviations: the changeset outside the claimed file surface is required by the changeset check for `skills/**` (accepted); the one-bullet edit to `evals/README.md` keeps the index true to the case file (accepted, and the index line matches the cases).
- Dev out-of-scope findings, each read against the tree and answered:
  - `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md:278` still says "The rendering side, `subforms` overrides included: objectstack-ui → Master-Detail Forms". Confirmed at the head: after this PR that section has no `subforms` override, so the pointer promises teaching that is gone. This PR is what makes it dangle. Escalated: a follow-up card on objectstack-data is owed (the same card can carry `showOnCreate`, which no objectstack-data file teaches although it is a field key).
  - `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:44` and `skills/README.md:125` route a stepped form over one object to a wizard form view: true only for a named form an action opens. Follow-up, same family.
  - `references/react-blocks.md:49` (generated) follows the spec describe text; carrier #36544 as the dev says.
- Two more, found in this read, outside the diff and not reviewed:
  - `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md` "Record Presentation", the `sections` ladder, step 2: "when one surface needs a local arrangement, a section may name a declared group". That section is about a record's create / edit / detail, and the new "Form Views" text links into it. On `main` no create or edit surface reads a form view's sections; the ladder holds only for a named or public form and the page blocks. The card's acceptance names two files and this is a third, so it is a follow-up, not a finding on this head.
  - `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:5456-5464`, the jsdoc over form-view `subforms`, still says the standard create/edit form renders as master-detail when it is present; `recordFormSubforms` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordFormNavigation.ts`) says an internal form's `subforms` is no longer read. The skill sides with the code. Spec comment drift, for whoever carries #36544.

### ④ Design judgment

Each taught sentence, read against `origin/main`:

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`
- "The dialogs, the full-page form (`editMode: 'page'`) and a create or edit an action opens are built from the object": holds. `AppContent.tsx:1791`, `RecordFormPage.tsx:296` and `useActionModal.tsx:289` all take `recordFormFieldNames(fields, flow)`; none reads a form view. `MetadataProvider` still merges `form` / `formViews` onto the served object, and nothing under `ui/packages/app-shell/src` or `ui/apps/console/src` reads them back for a record create or edit. A related list's child create and the lookup's "create the referenced record" go through the same two hosts. A flow screen's create (`ScreenView.tsx:441`) uses the same list.
- "sectioned by `fieldGroups` in array order": holds (`packages/spec/src/data/field-group-layout.ts`, declared-group order).
- "`collapse: 'collapsed'` on a `fieldGroups` entry folds a rarely filled section": holds (`object.zod.ts` `collapse` enum; `plugin-form/src/fieldGroups.ts` maps it onto the renderer's pair).
- "`showOnCreate: false` ... edit, the record page and lists keep it. Beside `required: true` it is refused, whatever its `defaultValue`: keep it on create, or make it `requiredWhen`": holds, sentence for sentence, against `field.zod.ts:2931` and the refusal at `:3255-3270` (the message names `requiredWhen` and says a `defaultValue` makes no exception). `isFieldAskedOnFlow` is create-only.
- "Dialog size and column count are derived, never authored": holds for the two console hosts (`resolveRecordFormModalLayout` passes `modalSize` only as the derived phone `full`).
- "A container's `form`, `formViews.default` and `formViews.create` still parse and steer nothing ...; `os validate` warns `form-view-internal-not-loaded`": holds. `validate-internal-form-views.ts` reports exactly those three sites (and a stored default or `OBJECT.create` form item), severity warning, registered advisory for all check commands; a `sharing.enabled: true` form and a form under any other key are never reported.
- "A named form ... registered as `OBJECT.key`; an action of `type: 'form'` whose `target` is that name opens it on its own page (`/forms/:name`)": holds (`view.zod.ts` container expansion; `ActionRunner.executeForm`; `ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx:456`).
- "`simple` ..., `tabbed` ... or `wizard` (a step per section, each listing `fields`, never `{ group }`)": holds (`view.zod.ts` type enum; the `group` on a wizard step refusal).
- "It draws no child line items": holds. `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` has no match for `subforms`, `relatedList`, `groupSubforms` or `MasterDetail`.
- The public-form paragraph is unchanged, as the card asks. Nothing live is taught as dead: a public form under `form` or any key still loads (the lint rule skips it), and the skill's "a form view with `sharing: ...`" covers it.
- "Master-Detail Forms": option 2 (form-view `subforms`) is removed. Justified: no create or edit surface and no named-form page reads a form view's `subforms`; line items on create and edit come only from `fieldGroups[].relatedList` (`recordFormSubforms`). Option 1 and the page block stay, and `taxRateField` is now attributed to the page block, the only schema that declares it (`component.zod.ts:7552`; `MasterDetailForm.tsx:1124-1126` reads it off the parent record, as the kept wording says).
- The container example's `formViews.triage` with `sections: [{ group: 'case_detail' }]` on a `simple` form is a legal named form.

`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`
- Traps 1 and the "Where to go" row say the same thing in short and point at "Form Views". Hold.

Payment cuts: the removed sentences about sizing the New / Edit dialog with `columns` and `modalSize`, `collapsed: true` on a form section, and the form-view `subforms` override were false for New and Edit on `main`. The type table survives as one sentence in "A named form". One true sentence is lost: see N3.

`skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`, under the literal grader (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/grade.ts`, case-sensitive substring):
- Eval 1: `expected_output` carries all seven `must_contain` tokens and none of the four `must_not_contain` ones (`groupByField:` is not `groupBy:`; `form` appears only in backticks, never as `form: {`). The prompt asks for an edit form, so the taught refusal is observable, and `form: {` pins it.
- Eval 6: carries `fieldGroups`, `relatedList`, `master_detail`; no `type: 'screen'`. Passes its own assertions. See N1.
- Eval 13: only the prompt's premise changed (`defineView({ list })`); assertions untouched.
- Eval 19: carries `fieldGroups`, `collapse: 'collapsed'`, `showOnCreate: false`; no `type: 'tabbed'`, and `modalSize` is never followed by a colon. The prompt's `loss_reason` clause makes `showOnCreate` observable. The expected answer is right on `main`.

`skills/objectstack-ui/evals/README.md`: the index line matches the four cases.

Security: no changed hunk teaches permission, sharing, credential, token or authentication behaviour. `showOnCreate` is presentation and is taught as such ("edit, the record page and lists keep it"); the public-form paragraph is context, not a changed hunk.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

N1 (nit) — eval 6 cannot tell the retired answer from the taught one. Its new `must_contain` (`fieldGroups`, `relatedList`, `master_detail`) is a subset of what the OLD expected answer already carried, and `must_not_contain` is still only `type: 'screen'`: the pre-change expected output (a `formViews` wizard plus the field group) passes the new assertions verbatim. `type: 'wizard'` is absent from the new `expected_output`, so adding it to `must_not_contain` is safe by the convention evals 1 and 19 already use. The skill text is unaffected; evals 1 and 19 do pin the internal-form family.
N2 (nit) — "leaves it off every create surface" (list-views.md, and Traps 1) is the spec's own phrase, and the spec's parenthesis bounds it to the create dialog, the full-page create and an action-opened create. `showOnCreate` is read only in `ui/packages/app-shell` (the three hosts and the flow screen): a named or public form whose section lists the field or references its group, and an `object-form` page block, still draw it on a create. The surrounding paragraph bounds the reading well enough; a word such as "every New surface above" would make it exact.
N3 (nit) — the cut drops the `tabbed` caveat (a required field on another tab is flagged only on its own tab; the tab strip overflows on a phone). It was guidance for choosing a layout and still applies to a named `tabbed` form; no other file in the bundle carries it. Not re-verified on `FormPage` in this read.
N4 (nit) — eval 1's new `must_not_contain` token `form: {` is also a substring of `platform: {` and `transform: {`, and of a correct answer that quotes the retired shape while telling the reader not to write it. Unlikely in a view file; a positive `fieldGroups` token in `must_contain` would pin the taught half without that exposure.
